note: Outdoor tranche. Parks, trails, beaches and waterfronts for LA, NYC and Bangkok. Unlike eat/drink/stay, authority here is PUBLIC RECORD rather than criticism: federal and state designation, a parks authority naming its own flagship, and published visitor counts. Known distortion: Bangkok has no obtainable visitor figure and no official flagship designation, so Lumphini sits at 28 where it should be 42 - see claude/NUM-outdoor-and-ranking-2026-09-19.md.
